name: Gathering Macro Rules
description: Macros for woodcutting and mining are currently allowed. Auto-combat or auto-mob macros are prohibited and treated as rule violations.

name: Greenhouse
description: Craftable at the Workbench. Each plot normally supports 1 Greenhouse; the Season 1 Premium Pass grants one additional permanent Greenhouse slot.
source: Official Discord announcements by Swaroff [PRTL], 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-05

name: Additional Quick Slots
description: Additional Quick Slots unlock after clearing Chapter 2.

name: Skill VFX Filter
description: Graphics setting controlling whose skill effects are displayed. Options: Self, Party, Everyone.

name: World Motion
description: Graphics toggle that can reduce environmental movement for a smoother, less distracting experience.
